title: Troy Rosario replaces Rhenz Abando at Gilas for Fiba window
summary: Troy Rosario was tapped as a last-minute replacement for the injured Rhenz Abando to the Gilas Pilipinas roster for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers. Coach Tim Cone said…

blocks.text: Troy Rosario was tapped as a last-minute replacement for the injured Rhenz Abando to the Gilas Pilipinas roster for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers. Coach Tim Cone said Rosario’s familiarity and ability to play multiple positions prompted the decision to have him fill the spot vacated by Abando. “We have asked Troy Rosario, our best ‘plug and play’ player to join us,” Cone said. “He lends us great versatility and obviously knows the system.” Rosario appeared during the fourth window of the Asian Qualifiers, playing a total of 16 minutes against New Zealand and Australia.
